data.long_meaning: Neelambari is a Sanskrit name that means 'Blue Lotus'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of purity, creation, and enlightenment. The name Neelambari carries the meaning “Blue Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neelambari usually hope their child will grow to embody blue lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
